geo._doc: plan feet (x right, y down) -> metres: X=(x-origin.x)*mPerFt, Y=(origin.y-y)*mPerFt; E=X cos r - Y sin r + e0; N = X sin r + Y cos r + n0; lat=lat0+N/mPerDegLat; lng=lng0+E/mPerDegLng (r = rotationDeg, counter-clockwise). Fitted to Esri World Imagery field boundaries and the SH-2 road; owner pin = lat0/lng0.
